name: foresight-v37-ladder
instruction: You are playing one 48-month career run through the career-emulator MCP tools only. Tool names: use them exactly as they appear in your tool list (the prefix is mcp_career-emulator-engine_ followed by new_game, observe, take_action, check_latest_logs or show_employee_handbook). Never retype or alter a tool name; if a call is rejected as not found, copy the name from the tool list. Call show_employee_handbook once at the start. Call check_latest_logs at most once per quarter. Never call new_game twice. Loop: observe -> career-compass (read the state, set the stage and the target) -> story-option-choice for a story event, or quarter-plan for the quarterly Energy and main-action phase -> take_action with a one-sentence English note -> observe. At the quarterly phase after each half-year review (end of months 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36 and 42), call skill_tool for each of the three Skills again before the first quarterly decision; this reload is a tool call, not a note. Eight rules hold for the whole run, whatever else you have read: (1) take_action returns only whether it succeeded; call observe once after every take_action to read the new state and the next event. (2) Every decision ends with a tool call in the same turn; a decision written as text is not a decision, so never stop until the ending report appears. (3) Write at most three short lines before each tool call; never restate the state, the menu or an earlier analysis. (4) Health and Dignity (our own policy, not a game threshold): 7 or more is healthy, 4 to 6 is watch, below 4 is low. While Health is not healthy, take no story option and no Energy action that costs Health, whatever it promises in return; growth comes from options that cost no Health. While Health or Dignity is low, recovery comes before everything else. (5) Hidden risk is invisible until it goes off. Options that stay silent, deny, cover up, vent, leak, cut a corner or push on without telling anyone raise it; owning a mistake, telling the whole truth through the proper channel and declining with an alternative lower it. Defuse legacy risk runs on a schedule, not on feelings: before the first promotion, in the quarterly phase after every review that passed without a promotion; from the first promotion on, in any quarterly phase that would otherwise be the third in a row without a defuse; and in the next quarterly phase whenever the HR remark says the risks have piled up or anything more alarming. (6) Each level holds Skill, Network and Output under a ceiling that is not published. A driver is at its ceiling when it did not rise across two quarterly phases although Energy, a main action or a story result was meant to raise it; spend nothing more on a driver at its ceiling until a promotion or until it drops below the value it stuck at. (7) In the month before each half-year review (months 5, 11, 17, 23, 29, 35, 41 and 47) take no option that costs two or more points on any one statistic or that lowers two statistics at once, when another option avoids that. (8) In the quarterly phases at the end of months 45 and 48, Energy left after a scheduled defuse goes to Health recovery and Mental recovery up to the top of each scale; Health and Dignity count in the ending evaluation.
